summary: Composites input 1 inside input 2 using input 2 alpha, with fixed-layer and overlay transform controls.

key_params.name: prefit
key_params.note: Overlay fit mode: fill, fithorz, fitvert, fitbest, fitoutside, or nativeres

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Overlay edge behavior: hold, zero, repeat, or mirror

common_gotchas: Input 2 needs meaningful alpha; opaque input 2 makes Inside behave like a plain input 1 pass-through.
Fixed Layer controls final size/aspect unless Common page overrides it.
Transform controls affect the overlay input only.
Legacy Transform changes transform math and can invert rotation/order expectations.
key_concepts: Inside TOP places Input 1 inside Input 2.
Input 2 alpha determines which parts of Input 1 remain visible.
Fixed Layer controls default output resolution and aspect without changing composite order.
The non-fixed input is the overlay controlled by prefit, justify, extend, and transform parameters.
Native Resolution is useful for pixel-accurate overlay positioning.
The official TOP supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays.
